summary: Oregon Department of Forestry lookout site 19 miles east of Springfield, Lane County: a 35-foot L-5 tower built 1942 replaced a 1930s cabin; abandoned in the 1950s and gone.

facts.design: 35-foot tower with an L-5 cab (1942), replacing a cabin from the 1930s
facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1950s; the register and firelookout.com both list the site as gone
facts.agency: Oregon Department of Forestry (Eastern Lane district)

events.note: Forest Log item quoted on the Rex page: a telephone line to be extended to reach an emergency lookout in Section 30, T17S R2E; the Rex page files it under Walker Point (East)
35-foot tower with an L-5 cab replaced the 1930s cabin
Register and firelookout.com give only the decade: abandoned in the 1950s

evidence.supports: first structure a cabin built in the 1930s; replaced by a 35-foot tower with L-5 cab in 1942; abandoned in the 1950s and gone
evidence.quote: The first structure on the site was a cabin built sometime in the 1930's. It was replaced by a 35 foot tower with a L-5 cab in 1942. The lookout was abandoned in the 1950's and is gone.

evidence.supports: same timeline on firelookout.com: 1930s cabin, 1942 35-foot L-5 tower, abandoned 1950s, gone
evidence.quote: 1930s: cabin. 1942: 35' wooden L-5 tower. Abandoned 1950s. Gone.

evidence.supports: July 1940 Forest Log item: an eight-mile telephone line
evidence.quote: The construction of an eight-mile telephone line

evidence.supports: Rex page files the item under Walker Point (East)
1940 item: line to reach an emergency lookout in Section 30, Twp. 17S., Range 2E
evidence.quote: The line will eventually be extended to reach an emergency lookout located in Section 30, Twp. 17S., Range 2E.

evidence.supports: administered by the Oregon Department of Forestry
location 19 miles east of Springfield in Lane County
Eastern Lane District of the Oregon Department of Forestry

corrections.proposed: Cabin in the 1930s, year not given; 1942 built (35-foot tower with L-5 cab)
corrections.why: The register's Built field reads 1930's, a decade, and says the first structure was a cabin. 1930 is not a build year for the tower.

sources.title: Walker Point Lookout Site (Eastern Lane FPA)

notes_for_editor: Record kind 'tower' matches the 1942 tower; the cabin came first. Elevation 3,812 ft agrees across the register and firelookout.com. No source describes remains or access today. The 1940 item is quoted second-hand from The Forest Log via the Rex page. Do not confuse with us-or-walker-point-western-lane-fpa, a separate site in Lane County.
